status: procurement requirements, not purchased or price-verified

items.name: Documented exclusion sleeves
items.minimum_specification: Untreated breathable material; actual aperture, polymer, seams and lot documented; qualify separately for each crop/target
items.notes: Six is a coffee fit-test quantity, not six independent replicates. Cacao sleeve size/aperture unresolved.

items.name: Smooth sleeve support hoops
items.minimum_specification: Hold fabric clear of flowers; no girdling or changes to measured load

items.name: Soft ties and closure clips
items.minimum_specification: Adjustable; non-scented; replace if closure is compromised
items.scaling_rule: count closures and spares from final sleeve drawing

items.name: Weatherproof ID labels
items.minimum_specification: Unique IDs; visible in photograph; archival-readable marker
items.scaling_rule: plants + branches/cushions + cohorts + sample containers + spares

items.name: Paired microclimate loggers
items.minimum_specification: Matched T/RH probes; target accuracy <=0.5 C, <=3% RH; side-by-side check; 1–5 minute interval
items.scaling_rule: one per simultaneous treatment environment; third for sham

items.name: Tape, millimetre ruler and optical scale target
items.minimum_specification: Known length reference at flower plane; do not confuse sensor pixels with object scale

items.name: Precision fruit/seed balance
items.minimum_specification: >=200 g capacity; 0.01 g readability; verify actual accuracy/repeatability

items.name: Pod/batch balance
items.minimum_specification: Capacity covers heaviest pod/container; candidate >=5 kg and 1 g readability for whole cacao pods

items.name: Traceable check masses
items.minimum_specification: Span expected loads and instrument requirements; certificate/uncertainty recorded
items.scaling_rule: one compatible set per balance range

items.name: Harvest containers and trays
items.minimum_specification: Unique label, tare, separate treatment/date; no pooling before identity recorded
items.scaling_rule: one per treatment/cohort/harvest batch plus spares

items.name: Field notebook, clipboard and markers
items.minimum_specification: Water-resistant; revision/correction history

items.name: Offline-capable field phone/tablet
items.minimum_specification: Clock, location, photographs; offline UUID records and sync conflict display

items.name: Rain gauge and wind meter
items.minimum_specification: Calibrated/checked; location, height, units and interval defined
items.scaling_rule: one weather reference per representative site

items.name: Coffee macro camera and lens
items.minimum_specification: HQ C/CS camera with 16 mm candidate; final object-plane resolution acceptance required
items.notes: See VIDEO_MICROPARCEL_EXTENSION.md for verified pilot camera SKUs; this generic catalogue does not override them.

items.name: Hive entrance camera
items.minimum_specification: Module 3 Standard candidate; direction/count validation

items.name: Recorder, power, media and verified backup
items.minimum_specification: Clock, loss logs, independent power, original clips and checksum-verified copy
items.scaling_rule: size by measured bitrate*recorded time plus reserve

items.name: Cacao macro optics qualification rig
items.minimum_specification: Object-plane scale for smallest visitor; adjustable stable mount and flower-depth test
items.notes: Coffee optics not automatically adequate; no fully qualified cacao lens SKU yet.

items.name: Magnifier or stereomicroscope access
items.minimum_specification: Field magnifier plus lab microscope appropriate to supported taxon/pollen task
items.scaling_rule: hours by specimens and reviewer availability

items.name: Fine forceps and approved pollen-transfer implements
items.minimum_specification: Dedicated or cleaned/dried between donor changes; recipient-flower manipulation technique validated

items.name: Compatible donor flowers/pollen
items.minimum_specification: Known donor ID/genotype, collection time, preparation and compatibility evidence
items.scaling_rule: actual recipient count*validated donor requirement; do not infer grains from anther count

items.name: Labelled specimen vials and storage
items.minimum_specification: Match preservation method to morphology, DNA or pollen question
items.notes: Pilot stock allowance, not collection target.

items.name: Filtered insect aspirator or collection net
items.minimum_specification: Appropriate tiny-insect capture method; avoid disturbance in scored cohorts

items.name: Preservative and cleaning supplies
items.minimum_specification: Laboratory-approved material, concentration, storage and instrument compatibility
items.scaling_rule: approved SOP usage per specimen + blanks
items.notes: Pollen-on-body examination before ethanol when required; do not invent universal chemical preparation.

items.name: Slides, coverslips and microscopy consumables
items.minimum_specification: Approved pollen-count/viability/tube SOP; include blanks and reference pollen
items.scaling_rule: allocated destructive flowers*slides per SOP + QC

items.name: Taxonomist and pollen laboratory
items.minimum_specification: Expert review at defensible rank; optional DNA barcoding with chain of custody

items.name: Habitat substrate and application containers
items.minimum_specification: Disease-screened locally appropriate material; mass/moisture/source measured
items.scaling_rule: prespecified dose*plots*applications; do not infer from published headline
items.notes: No automatic distribution of cacao pod waste; agronomist reviews pathogen/pest consequences first.

items.name: Soil moisture/nutrient assessment
items.minimum_specification: Method, depth, units, lab/probe calibration and sampling locations defined

items.name: Canopy/shade measurement kit
items.minimum_specification: Repeatable canopy photograph or appropriate calibrated light method; store method/geometry

items.name: Caliper
items.minimum_specification: Repeatable fruit dimensions; 0.1 mm readability sufficient for pilot

items.name: Refractometer and distilled water
items.minimum_specification: Range/accuracy suitable for predeclared juice measurement; zero/reference check

items.name: Controlled drying, moisture measurement and seed processing
items.minimum_specification: Document drying/fermentation/moisture basis; calibrated crop-appropriate moisture method
items.scaling_rule: separate batches per treatment and independent replicate

items.name: Blind sensory evaluation
items.minimum_specification: Adequate sample mass, standardized processing/roasting; random coded batches and qualified panel
items.scaling_rule: replicated processing lots, not one pooled sample per treatment

items.name: Protective housings, rigid posts and mounts
items.minimum_specification: No obstruction of visitors; no transfer of camera force to hive load cell

items.name: Treatment timing clock and task alerts
items.minimum_specification: Synchronized local/UTC times; log actual opening/closing of access
items.scaling_rule: one shared reference and device sync records
